main.description: Mosimo post extension (an element of dev.jisaku.mosimo.post ext) set by the Mosimo Bosai apps: whether the authoring device's OS reported a usable network connection when the post was signed. Signed by the author like any extension; relays must not add or change it. Not proof of Internet reachability, nor of how or when the post was delivered: a post signed offline may reach relays later. Omit the extension when unknown.

online.description: True when the OS had a default network at signing time (Android: an active network; iOS: a satisfied network path), false otherwise.
